title: 달빛 운하 우편선
description: 달빛 비가 내리는 마법 운하에서 수달 배달부와 비버 선장이 우편선을 타고 다섯 가지 변화를 찾아냅니다.
theme: 마법 배달부의 하루 — 달빛 운하 우편선 야간 배송
scene: A charming whimsical magical canal mail boat making an evening delivery in gentle moonlit rain, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. The full small boat is shown side-on on calm indigo water between warm cream-stone canal houses, arched bridges, brass lamps, teal shutters, and softly glowing windows. At upper left, one large hanging lantern is isolated beneath an arch; its broad glass chamber glows vivid turquoise. At lower left on the dock, one large burgundy leather mail satchel faces the camera; its flap has one oversized circular antique-gold clasp. At upper center, the boat has one large cream triangular sail, fully visible against the violet sky; its center bears one oversized bright coral-red five-point-star emblem. At center, the recurring friendly young otter courier stands on deck in a deep-teal raincoat, holding one large mustard-yellow umbrella with exactly six broad visible panels and a simple curved wooden handle. At lower right, a friendly stocky beaver captain holds one large bright-orange wooden paddle diagonally across a clear area of the boat. Add blank parcels, coiled rope, canvas mail sacks, lily pads, a few glowing fireflies, and distant bridge details only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the turquoise lantern chamber, gold satchel clasp, coral star sail emblem, yellow umbrella, and orange paddle large, crisp, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, addresses, logos, or clock numerals.
